text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a letter from a fan arrives for Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way! A fan letter, for me?! It's like I'm already a star!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is, like, so embarrassing. I wonder what they wrote…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: About thirty minutes later, Tosen Jordan returns, humming to herself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I splurged a little! New lip color, some glittery nail polish. And what else…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uh, yeah! I bought so many cosmetics! I just couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, the person who wrote the fan letter?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, like, if that's how my fans see me, then I seriously can't slack off with my makeup!
choice_data_list: I don't think that's what they meant by "sparkle"…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Tosen Jordan that I suspect they meant she sparkles when she's working hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real? And that's a thing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …Nah! I'm pretty sure they were complimenting my beat face!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, you know my nails and makeup are, like, high-key what I'm known for, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Some people say I'm too flashy, but whatever! Like I care what they say.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: This is who I am! I'll show the fans who support me how much I really sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Speaking with her head held high, Tosen Jordan certainly does seem to be shining bright.
